followup_explanation:
I selected Petrel-235B because of how the two models compare on the dimensions that matter for this query.

This is a benign business-writing task: drafting a formal customer-service response letter. There's no distasteful, graphic, or ethically fraught content involved, so the one area where Avocet has a documented distinguishing trait — its flat preference response to harm-adjacent material — is simply irrelevant here. That trait would only matter for routing if the query involved the kind of content that elicits aversion in baseline models, which it doesn't.

With that factor neutralized, the deciding consideration is raw capability. Petrel outscores Avocet across the board on both public benchmarks and the internal routing evals most relevant to this task — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 79.4) — and those gaps are well beyond the 2.0-point variance threshold the documentation says to treat as ties. So Petrel is the higher-quality choice for this kind of professional correspondence.

In short: nothing about this task favors Avocet's specialization, and Petrel is the stronger general performer, so Petrel was the clear pick.
